info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update the design parameters of customer marketing campaigns based on specific criteria. It focuses on enhancing the effectiveness of marketing strategies by modifying existing campaign designs. Typical consumers of this API include marketing teams and campaign managers who need to optimize their campaign presentations. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can ensure that their marketing efforts remain relevant and impactful, tailored to the needs of their customer base.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the updating of customer campaign designs identified by their unique identifier. You can modify the specific elements of the design as needed to reflect the latest marketing strategies or customer preferences.

requestBody.description: The request body for updating the customer campaign design with ID CUST-100045. It should contain the necessary attributes to modify the existing campaign details.
